A '''jeweler''' was commissioned by a [[Unidentified crime lord (bangle)|crime lord]] to create a [[Unidentified priceless bangle|priceless bangle]] for the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord's]] [[Unidentified crime lord's daughter|daughter's]] [[Marriage/Legends|wedding]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. However, a [[Unidentified jewel thief|jewel thief]] stole the bangle from the jeweler, and later sold it to the crime lord for a fraction of the cost.<ref name="Too Hot to Handle">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|Too Hot to Handle}}</ref>
